visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian woman with long dark hair and straight bangs, wearing a white zip-up hoodie and a thin gold necklace, speaks directly to the camera. She uses expressive hand gestures, touching her face and neck to emphasize skin texture. The background is a tidy indoor room with white storage cabinets and shelves containing various pink and white skincare products under bright, even lighting. (2) The scene transitions to the woman standing alongside another woman with shorter hair (Minshua) who wears a white textured jacket. They both wave and gesture toward the camera. Cutaway shots display macro close-ups of different skin types—dry skin with visible flaking, oily skin with prominent pores, and reddened sensitive skin—interspersed with shots of the main woman talking. (3) A demonstration shows a white cream being dispensed from a silver pump bottle onto the back of a hand. The woman with shorter hair performs facial massage techniques on the main woman, pressing her palms against her cheeks and jawline. A brief inset shows a person having foundation applied with a brush in a professional salon setting. Later, the woman uses a white, serrated massage tool on her scalp. (4) The primary woman returns to a solo shot, smiling and pointing toward the top of the frame where promotional text and a discount code appear. She maintains high energy with frequent hand movements and facial expressions, concluding the video in the same bright, white-cabinet interior.

The spectral balance is bright, emphasizing the clarity of the voice above the background music.
